blocks.text: LUCENA CITY — Classes at De La Salle University (DLSU)-Laguna campus in Biñan City were suspended starting Tuesday morning, Nov. 10, while office work was also halted. In a Facebook post, the DLSU Laguna Campus Student Government announced that, upon the directive of the Office of the Vice President for Laguna Campus (OVPLC), both in-person and online classes would be suspended starting at 10 a.m. Tuesday. “Office work likewise suspended from 12 p.m. onwards. Access to the Laguna campus is restricted,” the student government added. READ: Hike in school bomb threats prompts PNP review of response protocols University officials had yet […]...
